description: This file contains abstract class definitions for a generic display driver system in OrchardCore, including multiple class hierarchies for handling display and editing of models with support for different contexts and model types.

classes.name: DisplayDriver
classes.description: Abstract class providing base implementation for display drivers with generic model and context types.

classes.name: DisplayDriver
classes.description: Simplified abstract class for display drivers with only model type, using default contexts.

classes.name: DisplayDriver
classes.description: Abstract class for display drivers with specific concrete model type and context types, supporting model handling and display/edit/update methods.

methods.name: CanHandleModel
methods.description: Determines if the driver can handle the given model.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Builds the HTML field prefix based on the model and provided prefix.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the display result for the model.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the edit form for the model.
